game.title: Devil May Cry 4: Special Edition
game.blurb: Stylish hack-and-slash action game from Capcom, released 2015-06-23. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genre: Action. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped a few missions at a time, plus chapters drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Birds of a Feather to Cold Blooded
chapters.summary: The first four missions on the walkthrough list: Birds of a Feather, Porte de L'Enfer, The White Wing and Cold Blooded.

chapters.title: Trisagion to Profession of Faith
chapters.summary: The next four: Trisagion, Resurrection, The She-Viper and Profession of Faith.

chapters.title: For You to Ninth Circle
chapters.summary: For You, Wrapped in Glory and Ninth Circle. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: A New Beginning to Fortuna Castle
chapters.summary: A New Beginning, The Devil Returns, Forest of Ruin and Fortuna Castle. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Inferno to La Vita Nuova
chapters.summary: The last five: Inferno, Adagio for Strings, The Destroyer, The Successor and La Vita Nuova. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Boss Feats
chapters.summary: Beating each boss with an SSS ranking on Son of Sparda or higher.

chapters.title: Difficulty Modes, S Ranks and Secret Missions
chapters.summary: Clearing every mission on each difficulty, S rankings, Legendary Dark Knight Mode and the secret missions.

chapters.title: Bloody Palace
chapters.summary: Clearing the Bloody Palace with each character, fast, in Turbo Mode and without being hit.

chapters.title: Characters, Skills and Style
chapters.summary: Playing as Vergil and as Lady and Trish, learning every skill for Nero and Dante, Stylish Rank combos and enemy counts.

Fandom (devilmaycry.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://devilmaycry.fandom.com/wiki/Devil_May_Cry_4
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki has the guide under "Devil May Cry 4" (completion stage 2), and "Devil May Cry 4: Special Edition" redirects there. All 20 mission pages in its walkthrough are written (about 1,500 to 5,700 characters each), as are Bosses, Enemies, Characters, Weapons and Upgrades, Gameplay, Controls, Achievements and Unlockables (30 subpages, about 122,000 characters in all); the Walkthrough index page itself is short. The five mission chapters follow its contents order, four or five missions each; titles are reworded from page names and no text was copied. Its page categories include 2015, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, but the mission pages are named for the original campaign; the data does not show whether they cover the Vergil and Lady and Trish playthroughs that the Special Edition achievements name. Steam app 329050 is the Special Edition itself ("Devil May Cry 4 Special Edition" in the store list); no separate original-release app was found in the store list. devilmaycry.fandom.com redirects "Devil May Cry 4: Special Edition" to a section of "Devil May Cry 4", with about 280 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 42 Steam achievements is hidden, and none names a mission, so the mission chapters have no achievements; the bosses chapter names them by boss only.
